LanguageData.CA_LoreBook_Opening: The Marked Virus did not raise the dead. It left people alive, clever, cruel, and organized enough to end worlds.
LanguageData.CA_LoreBook_ResearchNote: Field diagnostics identify a fast terminal pattern: most victims resolve quickly into either Marked Men transformation or viral collapse, while rare slow cases last longer.
LanguageData.CA_MilitaryReport_01: Military Report 01: Infected subjects retain weapon use, speech, door operation, cover-seeking behavior, and group tactics. Do not approach as medical casualties.
LanguageData.CA_MilitaryReport_02: Military Report 02: Alphas coordinate nearby infected by sound, gesture, and remembered command structure. Remove Alpha units first whenever possible.
LanguageData.CA_SurvivorJournal_01: Survivor Journal: They did not forget us. That was the first lesson. The second was that they knew which doors we locked.
LanguageData.CA_AudioLog_01: Audio Log C-44: Rash presentation forms a marked vascular pattern across the face and neck. Advanced cases glow red under certain scanner bands.
LanguageData.CA_PlanetaryTimeline: Medical timeline: contagious close-contact exposure, infected blood contamination, fast terminal progression, rare slow infection, uncommon immune survival, viral death risk, and Marked Men transformation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Intro: Use presets for a quick difficulty pass, or tune each section directly. Editing any field changes the active preset to Custom.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PresetHelp: Presets rewrite the schedule, enemy mix, virus behavior, AI pressure, story UI, and performance settings at once.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_CasualTip: Slower raids, lower exposure risk, smaller hordes, and more immune survivors.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_VanillaLikeTip: Keeps the faction dangerous while staying closer to ordinary RimWorld pacing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_DefaultTip: Restores the intended baseline tuning for the mod.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_BrutalTip: Faster, harder, less forgiving raids with stronger infection pressure.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_OutbreakTip: Large outbreak pressure with faster spread, larger hordes, and faster corpse cycling.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RaidScheduleDesc: Controls when Marked Men incidents appear and how hard scheduled attacks scale.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnemyMixDesc: Controls which infected pawn types appear. Weight 0 disables that type; weight 1 is normal; higher values make that type more common.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VirusAndCorpsesDesc: Controls exposure chances, infection timing, terminal outcomes, and infected corpse reanimation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AIStorytellingDesc: Controls Marked Men pressure logic, strategic AI activation thresholds, storyteller integration, raid countdown warnings, and custom story events.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PerformanceCapDesc: Controls maximum simultaneous infected, cleanup intervals, corpse removal rates, world pawn tracking limits, and performance optimization settings.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UrbanBiomeDesc: Controls Marked Men presence in urban maps: ambush frequency, dormant infestation density, epicenter encounters, and survivor spawn chances.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UINotificationsDesc: Controls which messages, alerts, letters, gizmos, and info cards the mod shows in the user interface.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_ResetTip: Reset all settings to their default values.
LanguageData.CA_KillAnticipation_Desc: The predator's senses sharpen in the presence of prey. Reflexes quicken and focus intensifies with every hostile nearby.
LanguageData.CA_FreshKillSatisfaction_Desc: The rush of a clean kill. The hunt paid off.
LanguageData.CA_BloodthirstyCraving_Desc: The hunger for violence grows. It has been too long since the last hunt.
LanguageData.CA_OverwhelmingBloodlust_Desc: The battle consumed everything. There is only the kill.
LanguageData.CA_PredatorPatience_Desc: Watching. Waiting. The prey does not know it is already marked.
LanguageData.CA_LostSurvivor_Desc: A disoriented survivor has wandered to the colony's edge. They claim to have been separated from their group days ago and have been traveling alone since. Something about their story feels incomplete, but they seem grateful for shelter.
LanguageData.CA_LostSurvivor_Betrayal_Text:
The dormant Marked Virus infection in {PAWN_labelShort} has suddenly activated! The colonist you took in was carrying the pathogen without visible symptoms — until now.
{PAWN_labelShort} transforms before your eyes, joining the Marked Men. No warning. No chance to prepare. Just the terrible realization that the threat was already inside.
LanguageData.CA_DormantMark_Desc: A latent Marked Virus infection that has not yet activated. The host shows no symptoms and carries the infection without visible signs.
LanguageData.CA_BetrayedByColonist_Desc: Someone I trusted was carrying the Marked Virus. They were one of us until they weren't.
LanguageData.CA_LovedOneTurned_Desc: A lover, spouse, or close friend was taken by the Marked Virus. What was left behind wore their face but was not them anymore.
LanguageData.CA_SuspiciousOfColonists_Desc: If one of them was carrying the infection without knowing, any of them could be.
LanguageData.CA_MercifulKill_Desc: I put down a colonist before they could turn. It was the right call, but that does not make it easier.
LanguageData.CA_SurvivorArmor_Desc: A set of reinforced armor assembled from scavenged materials. Uneven plates, patched fabric, and improvised padding offer decent protection against the Marked, though the fit is far from uniform.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_RecruitBlocked: The Marked Virus has completely overwritten {PAWN_labelShort}'s will. They can no longer be recruited, their mind is no longer their own.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_SelfHarm_Bruise: {PAWN_labelShort} slams their body against the cell walls and floor, leaving dark, spreading bruises across their skin.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_SelfHarm_Cut: {PAWN_labelShort} digs their nails into their own flesh, tearing shallow wounds that weep blood.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_SelfHarm_Mutilate: {PAWN_labelShort} savagely tears at their own body, mutilating themselves beyond recognition.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_Suicide: {PAWN_labelShort} has killed themselves. The Marked Virus drove them to a final, violent end rather than allow capture.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_DeathReason_Suicide: Self-inflicted death driven by the Marked Virus
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_DeathReason_NeckSnap: Self-inflicted neck snap driven by the Marked Virus
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_DeathReason_BloodLoss: Self-inflicted fatal blood loss driven by the Marked Virus
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_DeathReason_OrganFailu: Self-inflicted critical organ damage driven by the Marked Virus
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_CosmeticScream: {PAWN_labelShort} lets out an inhuman, guttural scream that echoes through the cell block.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_CosmeticGrowl: {PAWN_labelShort} paces the cell, growling and muttering in a language no one recognizes.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_CosmeticLaugh: {PAWN_labelShort} bursts into manic, hollow laughter that raises the hairs on the back of your neck.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_CosmeticPound: {PAWN_labelShort} pounds against the cell walls with bloody fists, testing for weaknesses.
LanguageData.CA_RestrainPrisonerDesc: Restrain this Marked prisoner with heavy chains. Restrained prisoners cannot attack, self-harm, or escape, but the virus continues to progress.
LanguageData.CA_ReleasePrisonerDesc: Remove the restraints from this prisoner. They will resume attacking wardens, self-harming, and attempting escape.
LanguageData.CA_PrisonerRestrained: {PAWN_labelShort} has been restrained with heavy chains. They struggle against the bindings but cannot break free.
